QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_23

question.text: The Compliance Test Report (CTR) for AIFs is filed:

answer.text: At the end of every financial year by the Investment Manager, to SEBI, furnishing details of compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Chapter 11.3.2, SEBI has prescribed the CTR (Circular CIR/IMD/DF/14/2014 dated June 19, 2014) to be filed by the Investment Manager at the END OF EVERY FINANCIAL YEAR detailing compliance with AIF Regulations and circulars. **The Trap:** Other options invent wrong frequency or recipients. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in XIX-C/D. Distinguish from monthly/quarterly SEBI filings (different reports). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Build the CTR skeleton throughout the year — tick off each SEBI circular as issued, cross-map to your policies. Year-end CTR then compiles in a week rather than a scramble; and the cross-map doubles as a gap-analysis document for compliance audits.
